description: We are looking for an engineer to own our ingestion platform end to end. You will design and operate distributed services in Python and Go, run them on Kubernetes, and keep a heavily loaded Postgres fleet healthy under a sustained write path. The team owns its services in production, including on-call, capacity planning and incident review. We care about correctness under partial failure more than raw throughput. What we look for: strong fundamentals in distributed systems, comfort with AWS primitives, and a track record of shipping services that other teams depend on. Experience with Kafka or gRPC is a plus but not required.

Own our paid acquisition channels end to end, from creative testing through to attribution modelling. You will manage a six figure monthly budget across search and social, and report to the VP of Growth.
